text: Educational Objectives The main educational objectives of the Chemical Engineering and Technology major are to cultivate qualified professionals with advanced chemistry technology and engineering knowledge to meet the needs of the modern chemical industry. In addition, they will greatly improve their overall morality, intellect, and physical fitness for their future professional development. They will receive engineering training in the production of chemicals, materials, fuels, and pollution control, enabling them to contribute to chemical factories through design, construction, operation, and management, and to conduct technology development and applied research. Main Courses Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Chemical Transfer and Unit Operations, Chemical Separation Engineering, Polymer Chemistry and Physics, Functional Polymer Materials, Principles of Electrochemistry, Electrochemical Measurement. Advantages of the School The school has a strong faculty, including 26 professors and 20 associate professors. To date, more than 4200 students have been cultivated, many of whom now hold leadership and senior management positions. The school admits approximately 60 doctoral candidates, 80 graduate students, and 100 undergraduate students each year. Research Research at SCET aims to bridge the gap between laboratory-scale studies and large-scale industrial production. Its research spans a variety of fields, including functional nanomaterials for advanced fuel cell systems, electroplating, supercapacitors, molecular electrochemistry, high-performance polymer composites, optical materials, fine ceramics, catalysis and surfaces, bioinspired nanomaterials, organic luminescent materials, organic-inorganic hybrids, coordination compounds, and computational and solution chemistry. SCET is well equipped with facilities for spectroscopic analysis, surface and interface analysis, electrochemical measurement, and more. Degree Awarded Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering Careers Chemical engineers can specialize in the production of chemicals, materials, fuels, and pollution control. They can move into other areas such as entrepreneurship and consulting. Another growing opportunity is sales engineering, which involves the service and testing of various types of industrial equipment.
